mentions.name: IdleQuest
mentions.description: A from-the-ground-up recreation of the 1999 classic EverQuest as an idle/browser game. It features a custom real-time MMO server built in Go, a thoroughly implemented web client, and the classic UI recreated in React, with original data and graphics meticulously scraped, cleaned, and organized.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on IdleQuest for about a year. It's a from-the-ground-up recreation of the 1999 classic, EverQuest. It features a custom real-time MMO server built in Go, a very thoroughly implemented web client, and the classic UI recreated in React.
mentions.author: brynnbee
